testResults.name: lint-and-type-gates
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev ruff check src/harness/cli/supervisor.py src/harness/cli/trader.py src/lake/storage/azure.py tests/harness/cli/test_supervisor.py && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check ... && uv run --extra dev ty check ...
testResults.result: ruff check, ruff format --check, and ty clean on all touched paths after integration fixes; ty strict on the engine surface with no wall-clock, unseeded random, or network access inside the synchronous kernel (clock and sleep injected; TableKillSwitchPoller is an explicit adapter boundary)

testResults.name: composition-integrity-fixes
testResults.result: Integration fixed five composition-blocking defects found by focused review: SessionJournal now persists through the SnapshotObjectStore port (RuntimeStateStore exposes no raw store surface); _compose supplies the required kill_switch; the live inboxes compose without the nonexistent clock kwarg; boot recovery wraps SnapshotBrokerStatePort in a real RuntimeReconciler; periodic reconciliation passes ReconcileTrigger.PERIODIC with a correctly advanced sequence; __all__ exports the real phase class name

limitations: AC1 (a dev paper deployment survives a mid-session container restart) awaits live evidence: the deployed supervisor has not yet run inside an RTH session window, so no supervision document exists in harness-state. Execute the restart procedure from .github/runbooks/trader-operations.md during the next KEDA window (9:30-16:00 America/New_York), then verify runs/<run-id>/supervision.json shows restore/resume phases and the restart ledger bounds consecutive faults
